request.style: Latin, Renaissance sacred polyphony of the sixteenth century, a cappella mixed choir in four parts, sopranos, altos, tenors and basses entering one after another in flowing imitative counterpoint, no instruments, cathedral acoustics, serene and luminous, 64 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Quemadmodum desiderat cervus ad fontes aquarum
ita desiderat anima mea ad te, Deus

[Verse]
Sitivit anima mea ad Deum fortem, vivum
quando veniam et apparebo ante faciem Dei

[Verse]
Fuerunt mihi lacrimae panes die ac nocte
dum dicitur mihi quotidie: ubi est Deus tuus

[Outro]
ad te, Deus
